source_behavior.summary: Subscription & Billing exposes a visible secondary Email settings action that navigates to the account email-settings workspace.
source_behavior.success_semantics: navigation reaches the real tenant email-settings route; the control does not claim save, test, provider, or delivery success

runtime_path: authenticated user opens the explicit /tenants/{tenant}/account/billing route
auth and tenant.context activate the membership and billing.view authorizes the source route
BillingProfileLink renders the canonical Email settings control only in the account-billing RouteElement
the control derives the destination from authoritative FrontendContext.tenant.slug through tenantUrl
React resolves account/email-settings explicitly instead of falling through to NotFound
the destination server route rereads authenticated tenant context and requires tenant.view
the read-only destination requests the same-tenant email configuration only when tenant.manage is present
MailConfigurationService serializes configuration state without the SMTP secret

authorization.missing_tenant_manage: the client sends no configuration request and the API independently returns 403
authorization.guest: redirected to canonical login before source or destination data is exposed

tenant_isolation.tenant_encoding: tenantUrl and encodeURIComponent prevent path-fragment tenant injection
tenant_isolation.direct_id_surface: none; the navigation and default configuration read contain no caller-selected user, site, credential, provider, or billing resource ID

security_semantics.csrf: not applicable to the canonical operation because navigation and configuration display are GET/read-only; no state-changing request was added
security_semantics.session: Laravel auth session is required by the source, target, context, and configuration contracts
security_semantics.secrets: SMTP secret material is never returned or rendered; only has_secret boolean state is exposed by the existing serializer
security_semantics.queue_cache_scheduler: none; this operation enqueues no job, writes no cache key, and changes no scheduler state
security_semantics.wordpress_connector: none; no WordPress or Connector request is issued
security_semantics.billing_provider: none; no checkout, subscription, PayPal, or provider mutation is issued
security_semantics.ai_provider: none; no AI/provider request is issued
security_semantics.persistence: none; the canonical operation performs navigation plus authoritative reads only
security_semantics.idempotency: repeated navigation and rereads are side-effect free
security_semantics.truthful_failure: authorization or API failures render an explicit failure state rather than fake success

assertions: exact source labels and canonical operation marker
tenant-derived encoded destination and cross-tenant path rejection
explicit source and destination routes with exact permissions

terminality.reason: The source-faithful Email settings action is visibly mounted on the real Billing workspace, derives its tenant-qualified destination from authenticated server context, resolves to the already-terminal explicit email-settings route, reads only authoritative same-tenant configuration behind tenant.manage, exposes no SMTP secret, rejects foreign-tenant paths, and introduces no mutation or fake success. Exact-head focused and repository CI are recorded externally because a commit cannot self-contain its own final SHA.
